prb.title: Customer problems
prb.sub: What went wrong for visitors on the shop's pages, found by itself from real visits: one line per cause, Urgent first. No name, phone, address or payment detail is ever recorded.
prb.offNote: The recorder is off: the shop's pages report nothing. Switch it on in the card below.
prb.none: No problem reported in this view.
prb.glitchesH: Short glitches (seen for a few minutes, not since)

status.WAITING_OWNER_CHECK: Fixed, waiting for the owner's check

kind.script_error: A script on the page broke
kind.request_failed: A call to the shop's server failed
kind.slow_request: A call to the shop's server was slow
kind.form_stuck: A form field was refused again and again
kind.rage_click: Rage clicks (many quick clicks on one spot)
kind.server_error: A shop call broke on the server

prb.back: Seen again after it was marked fixed

card.d: What the shop's pages report, and when a problem is urgent. Nothing personal is ever sent.
card.enabled: Record problems on the shop's pages
card.enabledHelp: Off: nothing is sent or kept.
card.slowLoadMs: A page load is slow above (milliseconds)
card.rageClicks: Rage click: clicks within a second on one spot
card.formErrorRepeats: Stuck form: the same field refused this many times
card.maxPerPage: Most reports one page view may send
card.urgentVisitors: Urgent anywhere when it hits this many visitors in a day
card.urgentVisitorsHelp: On the bag and checkout one visitor is enough.
card.glitchMinutes: Short glitch: seen only within this many minutes
card.readOnly: You can see the recorder's numbers; changing them needs the settings permission.

d.noDetail: No message (the page itself was slow or failed)
d.note: Note (how it was fixed, why it could not be, or what the owner is asked)
d.noManage: Changing the status needs the problems permission.
d.ownerHint: Leaving “Needs owner permission” or “Waiting for the owner's check” is the owner's call.

err.NOTE_NEEDED: Write a note: how it was fixed, why it could not be, or what the owner is asked.
err.OWNER_ONLY: Only the owner (or someone he allowed) can move this problem on.
err.STALE: Someone else changed this problem; it shows their status now.
err.INVALID_INPUT: Pick a status and keep the note short.
err.NOT_FOUND: This problem is not there any more.
err.forbidden: You do not have permission to do this.
err.unauthorized: Your sign-in has ended — please sign in again.
err.other: That did not save. Please try again.

alerts.d: A line to the owner's Telegram (Keys & connections) when a customer problem needs him now. Nothing in the shop is blocked or changed.
alerts.enabled: Send Telegram alerts for customer problems
alerts.enabledHelp: Off: nothing is sent. Until the Telegram bot is connected, the lines go to the practice copy.
alerts.onUrgent: Send a line when a problem becomes Urgent
alerts.spikeVisitors: Sudden rise: one problem hits this many visitors
alerts.repeatHours: At most one line per problem within (hours)
alerts.readOnly: You can see the alert settings; changing them needs the settings permission.

alert.urgent: {store}: urgent customer problem: {kind} ({step}, {where}). {visitors} visitor(s) in the last day. See Reports › Site health › Customer problems.
alert.spike: {store}: sudden rise: {kind} ({step}, {where}) hit {visitors} visitors in {minutes} minutes. See Reports › Site health › Customer problems.
